{
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Reduce each separator-delimited panel to its background or marker."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    divider = grid[sep_rows[0]][0] if sep_rows else grid[0][sep_cols[0]]
    counts = {}
    for row in grid:
        for v in row:
            if v != divider:
                counts[v] = counts.get(v, 0) + 1
    background = max(counts, key=counts.get)
    signal = min((v for v in counts if v != background), key=lambda v: counts[v])
    def spans(n, dividers):
        out, start = [], 0
        for p in dividers:
            out.append((start, p))
            start = p + 1
        out.append((start, n))
        return out
    rows, cols = spans(h, sep_rows), spans(w, sep_cols)
    out = []
    for r0, r1 in rows:
        line = []
        for c0, c1 in cols:
            # Mark the panel if the signal makes a 2-cell orthogonal domino.
            marked = any(grid[r][c] == signal and (
                (r + 1 < r1 and grid[r + 1][c] == signal) or
                (c + 1 < c1 and grid[r][c + 1] == signal))
                for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1))
            line.append(1 if marked else background)
        out.append(line)
    return out
